semantics.management: Versioned contracts and deterministic gates manage role profiles; no manager-agent hierarchy.
semantics.proposal: AI roles may propose evidence-backed changes.
semantics.publication: No AI role can publish its own configuration or grant permissions.
semantics.authorization: Credentials, service identities, policy enforcement and release gates remain outside the model.

contract_types.name: Business Contract
contract_types.scope: mission, primary persona, objectives, KPIs, artifacts, business scope, conflict rules

contract_types.name: Skill Contract
contract_types.scope: skill descriptors and bodies, playbooks, knowledge provenance, artifact schemas, dependencies, eval cases, memory policy references

contract_types.name: Runtime Contract
contract_types.scope: model, effort, context order, caching, timeouts, cost, SLO, concurrency, failure and rollback

contract_types.name: Access Contract
contract_types.scope: data scope, visible tools, action intent classes, policies, expiry, revocation and audit

contract_types.name: Assurance Contract
contract_types.scope: eval suites, thresholds, conflicts of interest, independent checks, release gates, observation and rollback evidence
